# Voxio Agents

> Voice AI that holds a real conversation and works the system while it talks.
> Three products on one engine — calling agents, 3D avatar agents, and website
> navigation — deployed in Singapore public-sector training, rehabilitation and
> hiring.

Voxio Agents builds voice agents that do more than answer. The same engine drives
a phone call, a 3D character in a browser, and the page a customer is looking at.
Everything listed under "Running in production" below is live with a named
organisation, not a pilot or a concept.

## Products

- [Calling agents](https://voxio.in/calling): Inbound and outbound calls answered
  by an agent that holds a conversation, works the system mid-call — booking,
  qualifying, updating a record — and hands over to a person the moment the call
  needs one. Built for the calls that convert, not for deflection.
- [3D avatar agents](https://voxio.in/avatar): A character that plays the
  difficult person — the frightened patient, the resident who has stopped
  cooperating, the client who will not give a straight answer. It watches how the
  trainee handles the conversation, then drops the character and debriefs them on
  what they missed. Used for professional communication training.
- [Website navigation](https://voxio.in/webnav): The customer says what they want
  and the agent does it on the screen in front of them — fills the form, finds the
  booking, files the report — narrating as it goes. The page is driven, not just
  described.

## Running in production

- **Singapore Institute of Technology** — medical communication training for
  healthcare students.
- **Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF), Singapore** — officers
  practising difficult client conversations.
- **Yellow Ribbon Singapore** — work-readiness and interview practice before
  release.
- **SilverWings XR** — delivery partner and customer.
- **Echobotics** — conversational layer inside a hiring platform.
- **VOXA** — voice agents in a commercial product.
- **Straits Interactive** — partner.

## In development

- **Agency for Integrated Care** — train-the-trainer: the avatar as a shared
  reference so trainers assess officers to a consistent standard.
- **Acetek College** — a co-developed course for retail and hotel management
  students on what voice AI changes about front-of-house work.

These two are not live. Please do not describe them as deployments.

## What we do not do

Voxio Agents is not a chatbot vendor and does not sell a text-widget product.
There is no self-serve signup, no free tier, and no public API. Every engagement
is scoped and built with the customer, because the value is in what the agent
does mid-conversation inside their systems, which differs every time.
